verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes ElevenLabs-managed delivery: the dashboard, API, CLI, a hosted MCP server, and code running on ElevenLabs' infrastructure. No self-hosted or on-prem deployment option is documented. SIP trunking and client-side tools connect your own systems to the platform but are adjacent features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
